build_acceptance.chain: Independent official-lock-schema acceptance followed by record; deprecated lock.info.version is intentionally absent. Original unsuccessful postflight records remain preserved separately.

limits: No blanket security, complete provenance, legal-completeness or reproducible-build guarantee.
Runtime and adapter observations are separate from final application integration, generated HTTP, retained/export/Worker regressions, native browser and release approval.
The original runtime is retained for coherent rollback, not declared remediated.
Recovery toolchain/host/npm installation completeness is a separate checkpoint scope.

phase6.scope: Actual versions, imports, bounded XML fixtures, accelerated ElementTree 16-byte setter table-hook observation and startup CSPRNG; direct compiled pyexpat setter invocation is source-corroborated, not directly intercepted. The observed salt uses a process secret, not fresh per-parser RNG.

phase7.scope: Captured actual adapters with the reviewed strict-version derived engine; not final integrated production-engine/Worker or browser acceptance.
phase7.timing_comparison: Only explicitly enumerated accounting JSON pointers differ; model/route times and semantics stay exact. Resource-budget assertions remain enforced.
